distractors: Asbestos exposure and circumferential pleural thickening strongly mimic mesothelioma.
critical_safety_points: Do not conclude mesothelioma from asbestos history and CT alone; obtain cytology and tissue with immunophenotyping.
Account for baseline interstitial lung disease when weighing immunotherapy pneumonitis risk.
